import nanosurf
import time
import os

# Load application
spm = nanosurf.SPM()
application = spm.application

# Get scan object
scan = application.Scan

# Set scan parameters for 10x10 µm² image
scan.ImageWidth = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters
scan.ImageHeight = 10e-6  # 10 µm in meters

# Print current settings to verify
print(f"Image Width: {scan.ImageWidth * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Image Height: {scan.ImageHeight * 1e6} µm")
print(f"Points: {scan.Points}")
print(f"Lines: {scan.Lines}")

# Start scan
print("Starting scan...")
scan.StartFrameUp()

# Wait for scan to complete
scanning = scan.IsScanning
while scanning:
    remaining = scan.Lines - scan.Currentline
    print(f"Scanning in progress... Remaining lines: {remaining}")
    time.sleep(3)
    scanning = scan.IsScanning

print("Scanning finished!")

# Try to get the image path
try:
    # Check if there's a method to get the last saved image path
    if hasattr(application, 'LastImagePath'):
        image_path = application.LastImagePath
        print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    elif hasattr(scan, 'LastImagePath'):
        image_path = scan.LastImagePath
        print(f"Image saved at: {image_path}")
    else:
        print("Checking for saved files in workspace...")
        workspace = r"C:\Users\Admin\Desktop\corral\corral\tasks\afm\src\afm\claude-sonnet-4-5_subtasks_1_tool_calling\enviroment\subtasks_1"
        if os.path.exists(workspace):
            files = os.listdir(workspace)
            print(f"Files in workspace: {files}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"Error getting image path: {e}")

del spm
"}
